Agent Name: Planner

Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted the task by conflating nationality/identity with ancestry. Despite collecting evidence that both individuals are Armenian-American (indicating Armenian heritage), the Planner concluded the shared country of ancestry was the United States. The shared country of ancestry should have been identified as Armenia.
